coverage.reason: Read-only operator tooling: exercise account/config/response redaction, pagination, authorization request headers, API failures, exact integer counts, source/deployment drift, and refusal of incomplete realm/tenant/region/count inventories. Fixture integration verifies every request is a metadata read or aggregation and no production payload is persisted. No game client, rules, backend authority or build dependency changes; emulator suites are not affected.

Document observed snapshot/import/restore results, account and storage test coverage, integrations/access status, and remaining migration/cutover gates. Explicitly distinguish isolated rehearsal from live deployment; no gameplay or permission changes.

Read-only fixed-time source export and isolated local PostgreSQL import/restore. Test interrupted-page recovery, typed values, missing parent documents, cursor order, count/checksum/privacy failures, adaptive page limits, identity/hash completeness, overwrite refusal and complete real-database restore comparisons. No live writes, routes, scheduler or Firebase authority changes; emulator suites do not exercise the new PostgreSQL target.

PostgreSQL storage and pinned local dependencies, selected only by the isolated game rehearsal. Test typed values, ordering/cursors, literal FieldPath updates, conditional bulk cleanup, atomic rollback/change records, serializable callback transactions and path-locked blind writes with concurrent creation/merge/increment. Actual game initialization and season/PvP receipt tests reproduce large parallel map writes; worker and account tests exercise shared transaction behavior. No live backend selection changes.

Account migration library, with an owner-only LAN rehearsal prepared separately from live login: verify imported hashes, UID/provider preservation, revoked sessions including verification races, one-use actions, Google binding/nonce/PKCE, registration and reauthentication. HTTP tests exercise host/origin/CSRF, cookies, size/concurrency, private errors and return-path handling. Real preview tests cover isolated source preservation and no privileged-runtime startup. No live Firebase account or game-client changes.

Prepare locked local dependencies and an isolated fixture-only PostgreSQL database in the static job when the reviewed selection needs it. Preserve all required checks and emulator selection. Exercise workflow selection/push protections and the actual synthetic PostgreSQL test commands; GitHub independently verifies fresh-runner setup.

Prepare an expiring private account test with exactly one copied owner account, a read-only profile-existence receipt, loopback-only listener, LAN/host gating, overwritten trusted proxy header, blocked resets/registration/email, separate least-privilege PostgreSQL role and hardened OS service. Tests prove isolation, UID preservation, no snapshot overwrite, authenticated receipt access, expiry and runtime ownership refusal. Prepared Caddy adaptation and systemd unit are validated locally; actual administrator installation and real Google sign-in are separately verified. Existing game routes, player data, workers, monitoring and publisher remain unchanged.

Centralize existing SDK bindings without changing Firebase default references or game handlers. Register all 150 real exports in an explicitly isolated PostgreSQL runtime; no server/worker starts on import. Test current-realm initialization, actual PvP event deduplication, season closing/claims and unauthenticated/unverified/stale release rejection. Durable local jobs test atomic per-change dispatch despite out-of-order commits, immutable event snapshots, retry receipts, stale/late-worker write fencing, dead letters, bounded restart catch-up and New York DST. Existing Firebase emulator suites independently cover the shared entry point, season service, realm readiness and email authorization; external integrations remain disabled only in rehearsal.

Owner-only local HTTP and application permissions: pin the deployed/repository rule policy and protected-field contracts; real PostgreSQL tests exercise authorized and denied reads/writes, atomic checks, typed-input abuse, optimistic conflicts, cookies, origin/CSRF, source-IP spoofing, bounded independent listeners, deadline fencing and stale-session rejection. Existing rule emulators independently check the source profile/economy/session, cosmetic flag, army-read and verified-email contracts. Full differential policy and workflow parity remain a production acceptance gate. Reproduce a 600 KB imported save through the actual HTTP transport, retain the smaller callable budget, reject oversized writes, and prove operational diagnostics omit payloads and error messages.

Opt-in private browser transport; default Firebase initialization and live game URLs stay unchanged. Test real cookie/data protocol, transforms, typed timestamps, scoped cursors, transaction retries, listener aggregation and stopped/old-session responses. Isolate private update checks/PWA/storage and exclude no-store/private auth responses from caches. Existing login, realm admission, email and cache contract tests cover shared client dependencies; standard build/artifact checks cover the new static file. Desktop/landscape preview is a separate manual gate before production readiness. Exercise 30 simultaneous startup calls through a six-request client queue, cap pending requests, and reject queued/in-flight results on disposal so startup does not overwhelm the twelve-request server admission limit.

Fresh exact private game copy, source-preserving ingress adaptation, HMAC-only integration, explicit owner/expiry/LAN boundary, least-privilege service preparation, private static serving and independent browser storage. Test real schema copy/overwrite refusal, source integrity, secret restrictions, route guards, static traversal/symlink rejection and cache isolation. Installer hashes/config guards and Caddy/systemd syntax are reviewed separately; administrator installation and real copied-city gameplay remain explicit acceptance checks. No workers or external side-effect integrations activated. Test the scoped request-limit repair, installed-file/config checksum refusal, unexpected-route rejection and rollback after a failed proxy reload; preserve all data and live routes. Subsequent preview repairs also verify the previous installed repair receipt and the browser adapter hash.

The selected existing auth validator omitted the current cosmetics client dependency and failed before reaching its assertions. Load the actual dependency in its isolated VM to restore email/Google/session coverage without changing game behavior or stubbing away the requirement.
